entries.land_description: Frank-fort, ME, 12 mi from Belfast; mid-coast). I am a 39-year-old working class Lesbian separatist, artist and environmental educator with a long-time dream of an intergenerational Lesbian community (from infancy to very elderly), including a Lesbian burial ground. I'm currently living in Boston, but building May, Sept & Oct 86 - finally! Write c/o General Delivery, Frankfort, ME 04438 while I'm building. I will need a dyke(s) to cabinsit or rent real cheap through winter and maybe longer. housing/permanent structure this year, camping space, woods, uncultivated farmland.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl children, older lesbians, artists, working class dykes, 12-step Program dykes
entries.notes: No alcohol or drugs of any kind.

entries.land_description: (off Rte 27 at Kingston & Pembroke Town Line on Silver Lake). We offer scenic grounds and meaningful work experience with easy access to Boston and Cape Cod - secluded outdoor space available to groups and individuals for workshops, retreats, etc. Accomodations are rough (outhouse, barn kitchen) - ponds for swimming, fishing, canoe - organic gardens, small livestock, bees. 1 house, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members, girl & boy children, non-lesbian women, males (maybe), dogs on leashes, horses
entries.notes: Usual donation for camping $6 a night. BYO food.
